title: ERPNext 15 quotation, Standard print format, Classic print style, US Letter, 1 page
notes: Submitted Quotation SAL-QTN-2026-00001, 3 lines; Print Settings changed to print style Classic and PDF page size Letter (ERPNext ships no print format for Quotation). Captured from Frappe 15.124.0 (commit f1cf50cf9bbc) + ERPNext 15.124.1 (commit 4e0dce9ea8d3), printed through HTTP /api/method/frappe.utils.print_format.download_pdf with a logged-in session. Frappe (pdfkit 1.0.0) pipes the page on stdin and reads the PDF from stdout: `-` `-` at the end; the output `-` is replaced by {out}. Frappe passed `--cookie-jar /tmp/<random>.jar` (session cookie sid); that pair is removed. /tmp/frappe-pdf-<random>.html header and footer files became input/header.html and input/footer.html. Origin http://127.0.0.1:8000 rewritten to http://127.0.0.1:8765 in input/page.html and input/header.html (no www/ file contained it). No margin-top or margin-bottom is passed: the header and footer heights decide the margins. The footer page inlines the whole print CSS; the header page links it. JavaScript is disabled for the page but the footer's subst() still fills the page numbers. httpHeaders are the Cache-Control values the Frappe server sent. The text relies on fonts installed on the machine (Inter, then sans-serif): the print CSS has no @font-face. ERPNext parts (item, totals and taxes templates, document layout) are GPL-3.0; Frappe parts (print view, Standard format, header/footer template, print CSS) are MIT; the print CSS also bundles Bootstrap 3.3.1, normalize.css and HTML5 Boilerplate (MIT) and Quill 2.0.3 CSS (BSD-3-Clause); the letter head, logo and business data were written for this entry. See SOURCE.md.
